title: Needs improvement
body:
Great to have this app aboard, even though I’ve switched from Samsung to iPhone! I hope that one day the iOS-sHealth will be just as updated as the Samsung version.

Also, this version of the app has several bugs:
* From time to another, often several times a day, I get popups on my screen asking me to turn on Bluetooth so that my app can pair with a gear. I don’t have a gear, and it would be awesome if you implemented a way to turn these popups off.
* Monthly Global Challenges don’t show up on the together-tab.
* I’m required to verify myself every time I enter the together tab, after the app’s been closed. Not a very big deal, but just fix it, m’kay:).

title: Samsung Health and Samsung Galaxy watch active
body:
The Bluetooth connection is a bit off. The watch looses contact with the phone, even though they are in the same room, and even close together. 
All sync issues have been solved due to hardware problems. 

Problem solved! 18/06
Replaced my watch and the new one workes perfect! 

Jeg laster ned og installerer slik videoene viser, men den S health vil ikke koble til min klokke. Jeg får beskjed om at «ingen kroppsnære enheter er koblet til»

Den registrerer ikke puls, eller søvn. Det eneste som registreres er aktivitet, men det tror jeg det er telefonen som har registrert.

Update: 
Den har plutselig begynt å ta inn data fra klokken, den syncer fortsatt ikke søvn.

Update 15/06:
I did both steps, and it worked. 
But then it stopped syncing. I tried syncing again and repeated both steps this morning still no wearable device. Then when hiking in the woods i tried again, and it suddenly did. 
So I tried again later, and it wouldn’t. Even disconnected WiFi from both devices(as in the woods), didn’t work. Is it really supposed to be this unstable?

Update 17/06

Nothing I’ve tried works. Beginning to think that there’s something wrong with the Bluetooth signal. The watch is receiving notifications but it has difficulties sending information to the app. Am taking the watch back tomorrow to see if they maybe can replace it, if they can’t figure it out.

title: Sync issues
body:
The app (on iPhone 7) struggles with syncing with the Galaxy watch. Battery and storage space generally syncs well but steps and training data only randomly and there doesn’t seem to be a way of transferring it manually. 
Update based on response from developer: I had version 4.0.0.1 and it told me it was the latest one when trying to update. Nevertheless it works now after a restart of watch and iPhone, opening the watch app first an then being patient waiting for sync. Then when keeping the watch and phone close together and syncing regularly (by dragging down in the app) it now works.

title: Great, but misses on somethings
body:
Hi! 

I really like shealth, but one thing I miss is more options on weight-training using my Samsung galaxy watch. It would be great to be able to put together a series of exercises for one training. Would also be useful to be able to put in reps and series manually. Last, the most important, to be able to log in the amount of KG you lift. Otherwise its hard to track progress. This would be awesome, especially for those of us who uses galaxy watch + Iphone, as the app Gym Run is not available to us. 

Thank you!!
